description: Source code for unit test stubs related to WDMP (Wireless Device Management Protocol), including functions for parsing requests, forming responses, and freeing request/response structures.

methods.name: wdmp_parse_generic_request
methods.description: Parses a JSON payload to populate a request structure based on command type.

methods.name: wdmp_parse_request
methods.description: Wrapper around generic request parser, defaults to WDMP_TR181 payload type.

methods.name: wdmp_form_response
methods.description: Creates a JSON response payload from a response structure based on request type.

methods.name: wdmp_free_req_struct
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a request structure.

methods.name: wdmp_free_res_struct
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a response structure.
